# AddonDependency

Type alias · [Source](https://github.com/schmayterling/hibi/blob/main/src/shared/dependencies.ts#L2)

A CLI required by an addon. Installers are package IDs, never shell commands.

<details>
<summary>Declaration</summary>

```typescript
type AddonDependency = {
  id: string
  name: string
  command: string
  homepage: string
  reason: string
  optional?: boolean
  install?: {
    brew?: { package: string; cask?: boolean }
    winget?: string
  }
}
```

</details>
